items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: there was, uh, Jeff Kitchen, a clarinet player.

ctx.x: Well, uh, back to Frank Johnson. Who was the star of that band? Was Johnson himself a star? I know.

Was it a star? Um, no, it was, uh, it was a, uh, a good all-round band. That was the, uh, basis of it. And, uh, it was a great band to play with. Um. I remember the first time I, I played with them, uh, I became, uh, 50% better player straight away because, uh, everyone played so well, it was so easy to fit in with them. Um. They, uh, when they started, their star was, uh, just a big star. And then, uh, there was, uh, Jeff Kitchen, a clarinet player. Mm-hm. And after he left, um, Warwick Dyer, the trombone…
Well, uh, was Frank Johnson the first band you played with, or you played with Elie Wilhoff?
